linhas.en:
Caster's second SG.
"Poor Cook" is not a typographical error.
It's simply that Caster thinks she's a "Poor Cook";
she's actually a "Good Cook."
This misunderstanding seems to have happened
because her ideal level of cooking is way too high.

Though she may seem like an uninhibited personality,
Caster has a very modest and reserved family image.
She's has recently been attending cooking classes,
all for the sake of making delicious meals for her Darling.

             ◆

During the Holy Grail War, Caster didn't know basic dishes.
Love is the Magic that turns a microwave cook-woman
into a good wife and wise mother.

Will the day that Caster in a coverall apron
say to her Darling "Here, open wide鷙" ever come?
Even if it's 99% impossible,
I want to believe that dream will come true.
